symbols.evidence: The request record declares the JSON-bound field at src/main/java/com/poc/account/api/dto/AddressRequest.java:13.

The checkout form and saved-address display access `postalCode` at src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx:112 and src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx:119.
Its response DTO binds `postalCode` and copies it into the snapshot at src/main/java/com/poc/order/infrastructure/client/AccountClient.java:25 and AccountClient.java:41.
